note: Private RV park on Paducah's west side near Beacon Dragway and Paducah International Raceway, a few miles from downtown and the Lower Town Arts District; formerly Paducah RV Park & Campground, now part of the Unhitched group. The pond-side sites back onto a stocked catch-and-release fishing pond. Tent sites, two cabins, rec room, two dog parks, playgrounds, propane. --Claude
summary: Kept. $47/night flat (Newbook quotes Jan, June weekday and Saturday) - under the gate; 56 full-hookup 30/50A sites, pull-throughs; laundry, wifi; online booking. Pond CONFIRMED (sites 13-21, 22-26, 30-44 back onto it over open gravel). Google 4.6/21. Renamed Unhitched Paducah; phone and website updates.
